_comment: THIS FILE CHANGES WITH ELECTIONS/APPOINTMENTS. It must be served from a remotely-updatable source (backend config / CMS / remote JSON), NEVER hardcoded into an app binary shipped to app stores - the #1 recurring 1-2 star complaint across competitor apps (Citizen Now, Brisbane's app) was stale officials after an update cycle. Verify against uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates before every release and on a recurring schedule (see BUILD_PLAN.md content-freshness section).
refreshCadence: Re-verify on every app release, and additionally: after every presidential inauguration (Jan 20), after any Speaker of the House election, and after any Supreme Court confirmation/retirement announcement.
nextReviewDue: 2026-11-04 (midterms), and again in January 2027 when the new Congress elects a Speaker.
